title: National Geochemical Database on Ore Deposits: Legacy Data (NGDOD) — Modernized
source: U.S. Geological Survey (USGS), Geology, Geophysics, and Geochemistry Science Center
citation: Granitto, M., Hofstra, A.H., Schmidt, D.E., and Khoury, R.M., 2021, National Geochemical Database on Ore Deposits: Legacy data: U.S. Geological Survey data release, https://doi.org/10.5066/P944U7S5
coverage: United States — mineral deposits and mining districts
format: Two linked GeoParquet tables: samples.parquet (point geometry) + measurements.parquet (long format, join on row_uid)
processing_scope: No geological reinterpretation or machine-learning modelling was performed. This is a structural modernization only — normalized fields, consistent data types, and machine-readable metadata, while preserving the original geochemical measurements, spatial information, and provenance.
standardization_method: Analyte vs. identifying/metadata columns were split per source table using keyword heuristics on column names (see ID_COLUMN_HINTS in the build notebook), not a hand-verified data dictionary — cross-check analyte column meanings against USGS documentation files bundled in the raw download before treating this as authoritative for a specific element or deposit type.
pipeline: ScienceBase fetch -> Standardization -> Modern Format -> Validation -> Metadata -> AI/API Ready
